name: Garware Hi-Tech Films Ltd
title: Garware Hi-Tech Films Ltd - 500655 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 EBITDA up 29% to INR157 crore at 26.2% margin on tariff relief, but FY27 guide of minimum INR2,500 crore revenue (~18% growth) rests on new sun-control capacity arriving only mid-FY28 and on a pending anti-dumping decision.

utilisation.quote: our sun control lines are running around 75% to 80%

capex.quote: We announced an additional INR191 crore s investment in a new sun control film line, adding around 1,200 lakh square feet capacity
